request: Add carefully fitted arms while preserving the newly approved bottle hand positions

method.kinematics: Native six-joint Galaxea R1 arm solved BACKWARD from the immutable accepted Sharpa hand root. Per-side arm base inferred for each frame.
method.hand_parameters: Not optimization variables. No changes to root translation, root rotation, finger angles or scale.
method.mount: Existing +90deg Y Sharpa-to-R1 adapter, flange face x=0.03425, 12mm spacer; native dimensions, no axial wrist scaling.
method.fit: SAM2 sleeve masks supply visible forearm direction. Bounded arm-only line fitting plus rendered silhouette coordinate descent. No EgoDex pose supervision.
method.temporal: Sleeve endpoint sigma=1 frame; new arm joints capped at 0.3 rad per source-selected frame. Hand trajectory not smoothed.
method.composite: Reuse exact approved hand RGB and masks. New arms are a proximal layer, excluded from accepted hand mask and visible bottle/cap masks. Original human pixels outside coverage remain.

validation.tests: 12 passed: wrist hard constraint, native/FK adapter, joint mapping and occlusion invariants.
validation.visual: Inspected first/middle/end full frames plus nine distributed frames in contact sheet. Native wrist joins remain connected; right forearm is mostly outside image when the approved root is at/below image bottom.

limitations: This is visible-arm visual fitting, not a single fixed-base or shared-torso whole-body IK solution.
WiLoR virtual depths are not calibrated metric scene coordinates and must not be used on hardware.
No physical contact, collision or arm/hand interpenetration validation. The proximal compositing layer explicitly protects the accepted hand pixels.
Sleeve coverage is incomplete. No inpainting or human-arm removal outside robot coverage.
Right hand root is near/outside the lower frame boundary in some accepted frames. It was not shifted to make the arm visible.
pilot_provenance: Two three-frame pilots retained. V1 initialized mirrored arm joint signs incorrectly; corrected using actual vendor limits before full render.
preservation: No previous results overwritten, no training jobs changed, no commit/push/server, all own jobs finished.
